# AI Snacks

> Small, self-contained reference pages for AI developer tools. One HTML file each, checked against the tool rather than its documentation.

Every page is a single self-contained HTML file with no external requests. Facts on each page were
checked against the tool itself rather than its documentation; where the two disagree, the page
follows the tool and says so.

## Pages

- [Claude Code Command Index](https://johnmiroki.github.io/ai-snacks/claude-code-cheatsheet/): every slash command, bundled skill, `claude` CLI subcommand
  and launch flag in Claude Code build 2.1.220 — 143 commands and 57 flags, extracted from
  the installed binary, probed for availability, and linked to the official docs.
- [Claude Code Bundled Skills](https://johnmiroki.github.io/ai-snacks/claude-code-built-in-skills/): the complete prompt behind every skill bundled inside build
  2.1.220 — all 35 of them, 62,010 words in total, read out of the shipped binary and
  reproduced verbatim rather than summarised.
- [Codex CLI Command Index](https://johnmiroki.github.io/ai-snacks/codex-cheatsheet/): every slash command, `codex` subcommand, launch flag and feature
  flag in OpenAI Codex CLI build 0.146.0 — 122 commands, 21 flags and 100
  feature switches, read out of the running CLI and probed for availability.

## Machine-readable data

- [Claude Code commands as Markdown](https://johnmiroki.github.io/ai-snacks/claude-code-cheatsheet/commands.md): the full command index as plain Markdown.
- [Claude Code commands as JSON](https://johnmiroki.github.io/ai-snacks/claude-code-cheatsheet/commands.json): the same inventory as structured data, with
  descriptions, aliases, argument hints, availability and documentation links per command.
- [Claude Code skill prompts as Markdown](https://johnmiroki.github.io/ai-snacks/claude-code-built-in-skills/skills.md): every bundled skill's prompt in full.
- [Claude Code skill prompts as JSON](https://johnmiroki.github.io/ai-snacks/claude-code-built-in-skills/skills.json): the same prompts as structured data, with
  the description, trigger hint, gating and assembly method per skill.
- [Codex CLI commands as Markdown](https://johnmiroki.github.io/ai-snacks/codex-cheatsheet/codex-commands.md): the full Codex index as plain Markdown.
- [Codex CLI commands as JSON](https://johnmiroki.github.io/ai-snacks/codex-cheatsheet/codex-commands.json): the same inventory as structured data,
  with how each command's availability was established, plus the whole feature table.
- [Everything as one file](https://johnmiroki.github.io/ai-snacks/llms-full.txt): every page's Markdown concatenated.

- [Source repository](https://github.com/johnmiroki/ai-snacks): all pages, hand-built, no framework.
